Daughter of Actor Chad Lowe Dies at 13: Fiona Hepler Lowe
Actor Chad Lowe and producer Kim Painter announced the death of their 13-year-old daughter, Fiona Hepler Lowe, on September 29, 2026, reported. The family confirmed the loss in a statement shared with PEOPLE, remembering Fiona as a smart, creative young girl who loved to dance.
Fiona was born on November 16, 2012, as the middle child among three daughters born to Lowe and Painter. She was 13 years old and would have turned 14 in November 2026.
Lowe Family Shares Statement on Fiona's Death
The Lowe family’s statement shared limited details regarding the circumstances of Fiona’s death. “We are deeply heartbroken by the loss of our beloved Fiona,” the family stated. They described her as a child who was adored by her sisters and deeply loved by her parents, adding that she was the light of their lives.
While the statement did not indicate a cause or circumstance of death, the family included information for the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. Following the public announcement, loved ones and industry colleagues expressed their heartbreak over the loss across various public platforms.
Remembering Fiona Hepler Lowe
The family’s public reflections highlighted Fiona’s creativity and her affection for dance. In November 2025, Chad Lowe marked her milestone entry into her teenage years by sharing a photograph of her smiling in cowboy boots with the caption celebrating her officially becoming a teen.
Fiona occasionally joined her parents and sisters at public industry events. In February 2023, the family attended the red carpet premiere for Disney and Marvel’s Moon Girl and Devil Dinosaur at the Walt Disney Studios lot in Burbank.
Background on Chad Lowe and Kim Painter
Chad Lowe, 58, built a decades-long career in television and film, earning an Emmy Award for his role as Jesse McKenna on the ABC drama Life Goes On. His extensive television credits include Melrose Place, ER, 24, Pretty Little Liars, and 9-1-1: Lone Star, alongside work as a director.
Kim Painter, 52, works as a film and television producer. The couple began dating in 2007, welcomed their eldest daughter in May 2009, and married on August 28, 2010, in Los Angeles. They have generally maintained a private family life while occasionally appearing together at charitable and industry gatherings.
“We ask for privacy and prayers as we navigate this profound grief.”
